notes.title: Release - Feature Update 4 + Free DLC
notes.notes:
After months and months of development, the first Free DLC Update is now available. Apocalypse: The Framework! This is bundled together inside inside the fourth feature update, adding 2 brand new maps, gameplay improvements, fog reduction, visual improvements, DLSS, and much more. Aside from the usual changelog, here's an explanation for both:

 Apocalypse: The Framework 
So as you've probably noticed the development has been quiet for awhile, this was to make time for my first DLC Update! Completely free. This is a complete level creation system, built for creating hundreds of different types of maps for Apocalypse. Over 350 Props (interior and exterior), a brand-new visual style, an event system, and complete flexibility over zombies, loot containers, style, and much more. Easy to use and accessible from the main menu, just export any level you've created and instantly play it from the map selection screen, or share with friends instead. Modding support will be available soon.

 Fog Reduction, Visual Tweaks, and DLSS
The Fog has generally been lowered throughout the entire game and all the visuals are much more consistent between areas and states. Night maps look significantly better too and all interior maps have had a pass with new props and models. DLSS is now officially supported too!

 (Edit) Steam Achievements 
The latest hotfix fixes all the issues related to older achievements, and adds a few more! With the new total around 24, although none of the additions are challenging they do now cover the entire game's content. This has been fully tested and upon release every achievement is now unlockable:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540438/a6ed79689e09f1f3da8841f69778599bb2ce887a.png

 2 New Maps! 
There's 2 brand new maps, all with assets never seen before in apocalypse! These maps add more variety to the current selection. Firstly, 'Destroyed City Tunnel' is a map based inside the subway, with 1 simple lane you need to defend. The 'F.O.B Public Testing Site', is a map based inside a destroyed and apocalyptic wasteland. There's also some bug-fixes from the community discussion. This includes achievement fixes, loading fixes, and much more! See the changelog below, also available in-game:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540438/704ad0a1f4d6201d91fde03dac846d5061a59744.png

notes.title: Release - Patch 15
notes.notes:
Another patch has released, this time the size of a content update! Focusing on making multiplayer much more reliable, LAN Redone, Recoil Redone, and a new close quarters map! Also including AI Intelligence, Optimisation, Resolution Settings Redone, Windowed Mode, and More. Here's some in depth info:

 Multiplayer Fixed / Reliability
Since I launched multiplayer there's been heaps of players checking out new features, and I love the feedback! However there was a large amount of much needed 'quality-of-life' changes. This simply improves the stability, reliability, and makes it easier to connect! Eg, joining or hosting servers is very unlikely to kick you back to the main menu (or in a frozen loading screen in some cases), LAN mode has also been re-done, server names are smaller, and over 20 other fixes.

 Zombie Optimisation / Improvements 
Zombie's are now a little different, for a start they're all much more efficient and optimised, they're also going to walk around much less (like after spawning) and sprint instead, they also go much closer to the player camera (this improves animation visuals), and finally you can adjust the zombie intelligence from the settings menu (for those favouring performance).

 1 Completely New Map
There's now the Destroyed City Subway, inspired by the Legacy Hospital map but improved in most ways. It's 1 lane running along a modern subway train, giving you a very challenging experience.

 Recoil Re-Done 
Recoil is now split in 3 new parts! The aim of this is to make firing and aiming a little more challenging, and to give the player a feel for the weapons. The first change is to simply reduce the current system slightly, making the line of fire more accurate. The second is to move the players camera (and mouse) when firing, this makes the combat feel much more fluid. Finally, every weapon also now has completely different unique values.

 and Much More! 
Not only are these changes being added, but there's also heaps of bug-fixes and features I've added from the community discussion. This includes Map List Improvements, Mouse Visibility Improvements, Spawning Light Fixes  (at night), and much more! See the changelog below:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540438/2acffd57bfdbdf6c0dd16613de0f9270cbaf3553.png

notes.title: Release - Feature Update 2
notes.notes:
Another feature update has released, and with fixes out the way this update focuses on just adding content! Here's a list with the new additions, and an explanation for each:

 Marketplace 
You can now purchase and sell items! Items are purchased at the Market Value and then Sold at 75% of the Market Value. Most items available can be purchased, however the more rare the item, the more expensive. I'm trying to balance prices as best as i can after this update is public.

 2 New Maps 
There's 2 new maps based around the F.O.B faction (from lore in the first game). The first is the F.O.B Research Centre, which is a large sized lobby area with offices attached. The second map is the F.O.B Laboratory, which is a medium sized lab used for experimentation.

 New Standard Operation 
A modified 'F.O.B Laboratory' map is also part of a new Standard Operation, called 'Classic Push', the aim is to push into the map and collect an item quickly, in this case 'Research Documents'. 

 1 New Weapon 
The new weapon is the Galil! This is Fully-Auto, fires every 0.2 seconds, and kills in 2 shots. The weapon fits inbetween the AK and the G-36 in terms of power, rate of fire and damage.

 3 New Usable Items 
There's 3 new Items, the first is a 'Flash Grenade' (common), which has a 2 second fuse and stuns zombies for 3 - 5 seconds. The second is a 'Headset' (rare), this reduces fog in all types. The last item is 'Improved Torch Batteries' (rare), this increases the light from your torch on night maps.

 and Much More! 
Not only are these changes being added, but there's also heaps of bug-fixes and features I've added from the community discussion. This includes Item Tooltips, a new Main Menu, Performance Mode Fixes, and much more! See the changelog below, also available in-game:

notes.title: Release - Feature Update 1
notes.notes:
The largest update has released, introducing several game-changing features, and ultimately improving the game flow! Here's a list with the new gameplay features, and an explanation for each:

 New Game Economy
This doesn't mean micro-transactions (they won't be added), this means that depending on the map, time of day (day or night) and depending on the type of run (cash or supplies) you'll get rewards for surviving as long as possible. After leaving, you'll be able to look through the supplies you've found.

 Item Marketplace 
This will be used for trading supplies or cash for usable items (eg, grenades, armour). Not to be misinterpreted as micro-transactions, this will solely be used for in-game items without any real cash.

 Custom Operations
From now on any matches you create are called Custom Operations, this is when you choose the map, the time of day, and the run. This is very similar to the previous matches created.

 Standard Operations
A new feature being added is Standard Operations, which is when the game chooses a custom mission with a unique set of objectives. When starting it'll cost your character a fee, however the reward is much higher if finished without being killed. The first Operation has been added!

 Game Extraction
Lasting a long time to gain heaps of cash or supplies is a good thing, but you need to extract in order to collect your reward. Simply press the extract key and it'll take your character 30 seconds to leave, however, if you die or quit the reward is lost. Some Operations can disable this for a location instead.

 Disabled Features 
I'll be disabling the Marketplace and Inventory while i make sure everything else (like the economy) works as expected, if everything is good I'll quickly enable them after the patch is released.

 and Much More! 
Not only are these changes being added, but there's also heaps of bug-fixes and features I've added from the community discussion. This includes optimisation, a new AK, Med Kits, a new Weapon (Bizon SMG), and much more! See the changelog below, also available in-game:
